response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The inner JOIN drops telescopes with no matching observatory, as the request specifies. Because observatories.observstation is the primary key, each telescope matches at most one observatory, so COUNT(*) counts each telescope once.
Telescopes whose observatory has a NULL lunarstage form their own NULL moon-phase group rather than being excluded, since the request does not say to drop them.
Rows with equal counts at the 10th position are ordered arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-breaker.
